title: A Monsoon for the Summit
author: M. M. Crane
blurb: Hazel Reyes, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
